grammar_title: -ing 分词作状语(时间/伴随、原因、与 -ed 分词的主动/被动区别)
source: 外研社版必修第二册 Unit 4 Using language:-ing as adverbial。句子地道、答案唯一(逻辑主语主动→-ing;被动→-ed;不定式表目的、谓语动词均讲不通)。零术语、全应用型。

points.point: -ing 分词作时间/伴随状语(主动、与谓语同时发生)
points.overview: 当状语的逻辑主语与主句主语一致、且主动地做这个动作、并与主句动作同时发生时,用现在分词(-ing)。它相当于 when/while/as 引导的时间状语或表示伴随的情况。

points.point: -ing 分词作原因状语(因为……所以……)
points.overview: 现在分词放在句首(常带 Not / Being / Having)表示原因,相当于 because/as/since 引导的原因状语;逻辑主语主动产生这一原因,故用 -ing,而非被动 -ed、表目的的不定式或谓语动词。

points.point: -ing 与 -ed 分词作状语:主动用 -ing,被动用 -ed
points.overview: 看状语的逻辑主语(=主句主语)与该动作的关系:主语主动发出动作用现在分词(-ing);主语承受动作(常带 by)用过去分词(-ed)。不定式、谓语动词形式均不能作此类状语。

questions.stem: ____ the sad ending of the play, many in the audience could not hold back their tears.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the audience 主动观看、与流泪同时发生、无连词 → 用现在分词作时间状语;观众不是被看,被动讲不通,不定式表目的与情绪反应不搭。

questions.stem: She walked slowly onto the stage, ____ at the cheering crowd.
questions.explanation: 她一边走一边对观众微笑,表伴随、与主句同时发生 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ the curtain rise, the whole theatre fell silent at once.
questions.explanation: 主语(剧场里的人)主动看到幕布升起,表时间、同时发生 → 现在分词;被动、不定式、谓语动词都不成立。

questions.stem: The old actor sat backstage, ____ quietly to the music from the orchestra.
questions.explanation: 他坐着的同时静静地听音乐,表伴随 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ for the school play every evening, the students slowly grew more confident.
questions.explanation: 学生主动排练、并随之变得自信,表时间/伴随 → 现在分词;被动讲不通。

questions.stem: He left the cinema in a hurry, ____ his phone behind on the seat.
questions.explanation: 匆匆离开的同时把手机落下,表伴随结果 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ the final song, the children clapped and shouted with joy.
questions.explanation: 孩子们主动听到最后那首歌、并随之欢呼,表时间 → 现在分词;孩子不是被听,被动错。

questions.stem: The dancers moved across the stage, ____ their arms like the wings of a bird.
questions.explanation: 舞者移动的同时挥动手臂,表伴随动作 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ in the front row, we could see every detail of the performers' costumes.
questions.explanation: 我们坐在前排(主动、与看得清同时),表时间/伴随 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: She read the script on the bus, ____ notes in the margin as she went.
questions.explanation: 她读剧本的同时在空白处做笔记,表伴随 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ along to the music, the audience swayed gently in their seats.
questions.explanation: 观众主动跟唱、同时摇摆,表伴随 → 现在分词;观众不是被唱,被动错。

questions.stem: The host welcomed us warmly, ____ each guest by name.
questions.explanation: 主持人欢迎我们的同时逐一称名问候,表伴随 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ the comedy show, we laughed so hard that our cheeks hurt.
questions.explanation: 我们看喜剧的同时大笑,表时间 → 现在分词;表目的、被动均不合逻辑。

questions.stem: He stood alone in the spotlight, ____ for the music to begin.
questions.explanation: 他站着的同时等待音乐响起,表伴随 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ down the lights, the stage manager signalled that the play was about to start.
questions.explanation: 舞台监督主动调暗灯光、随即示意开演,表时间 → 现在分词;他不是被调暗,被动错。

questions.stem: The little girl watched the ballet, ____ her eyes wide with wonder.
questions.explanation: 她看芭蕾的同时睁大眼睛,表伴随状态 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ the theatre after the show, the fans were still talking about the music.
questions.explanation: 粉丝离开剧院的同时仍在谈论音乐,表时间 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: She practised her lines in front of the mirror, ____ every gesture again and again.
questions.explanation: 她对镜练台词的同时反复重复每个动作,表伴随 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ to the radio play in the dark, I could picture every scene in my mind.
questions.explanation: 我听广播剧的同时在脑中想象画面,表时间 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: The crowd poured out of the concert hall, ____ the songs they had just heard.
questions.explanation: 人群涌出的同时哼着刚听到的歌,表伴随 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ a huge fan of Peking Opera, Lucy watched the same show three times.
questions.explanation: 句首表原因(因为是铁杆戏迷),逻辑主语主动 → 用 Being;Been 不能独立作状语,不定式表目的、谓语动词均错。

questions.stem: Not ____ what the plot was about, the foreign guests felt a little lost.
questions.explanation: 因为不了解情节(原因),逻辑主语主动 → Not + 现在分词;被动、不定式、谓语动词都不成立。

questions.stem: ____ confident about her lines, she stepped onto the stage without any fear.
questions.explanation: 因为对台词有信心(原因) → 现在分词;她主动产生这种感受,被动错。

questions.stem: ____ no tickets for the evening show, we decided to watch the matinee instead.
questions.explanation: 因为没有晚场票(原因) → Having;谓语动词、不定式都不能这样作状语。

questions.stem: ____ that the film was based on a true story, many viewers were deeply moved.
questions.explanation: 因为得知影片改编自真事(原因) → 现在分词;观众主动知道,被动错。

questions.stem: ____ up in a family of actors, he loved the theatre from a young age.
questions.explanation: 因为在演员家庭长大(原因) → 现在分词;grow up 为主动行为,被动错。

questions.stem: Not ____ the language of the opera, the tourists relied on the subtitles to follow the story.
questions.explanation: 因为听不懂歌剧语言(原因) → Not + 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ such a moving story, the documentary touched audiences all over the world.
questions.explanation: 因为讲述了如此动人的故事(原因),纪录片主动讲述 → 现在分词;被动 Told 讲不通。

questions.stem: ____ from a bad cold, the lead singer had to cancel the concert.
questions.explanation: 因为得了重感冒(原因),suffer from 为主动 → 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ how difficult the dance was, I admired the performers even more.
questions.explanation: 因为意识到舞蹈之难(原因) → 现在分词;我主动意识到,被动错。

questions.stem: ____ a deep love of cinema, the two friends often watched films together.
questions.explanation: 因为共同热爱电影(原因) → 现在分词;两人主动分享这份喜爱,被动错。

questions.stem: ____ that the theatre was about to close, we hurried to buy the last tickets.
questions.explanation: 因为看到剧院快关门(原因) → 现在分词;我们主动看到,被动错。

questions.stem: ____ how the story would end, the readers could not put the novel down.
questions.explanation: 因为想知道故事结局(原因) → 现在分词。

questions.stem: ____ both music and drama, she fell in love with opera at once.
questions.explanation: 因为既喜欢音乐又喜欢戏剧(原因) → 现在分词;她主动喜欢,被动错。

questions.stem: ____ that the show might be cancelled, the fans kept checking their phones.
questions.explanation: 因为担心演出可能取消(原因) → 现在分词;此处需要句首分词状语,谓语动词形式错。

questions.stem: ____ time before the show, we grabbed a quick dinner near the theatre.
questions.explanation: 因为开演前时间不够(原因) → 现在分词;lack 在此为主动,被动错。

questions.stem: ____ romantic stories, she could not wait to see the new ballet.
questions.explanation: 因为喜爱浪漫的故事(原因) → 现在分词;她主动喜爱,被动错。

questions.stem: ____ the last bus home, the fans had to walk back after the concert.
questions.explanation: 因为错过了末班车(原因) → 现在分词;粉丝主动错过(没赶上),被动错。

questions.stem: ____ to get a good seat, we arrived at the cinema an hour early.
questions.explanation: 因为希望抢到好座位(原因) → 现在分词;Hoping to do 常作原因状语,谓语动词形式错。

questions.stem: ____ far from any theatre, the village children rarely saw a live play.
questions.explanation: 因为住得离剧院很远(原因) → 现在分词;live 在此为主动,被动错。

questions.stem: ____ the orchestra, the conductor raised his hands for silence.
questions.explanation: 指挥主动面对乐队 → 现在分词;他不是被面对,过去分词表被动错。

questions.stem: ____ by the loud applause, the actor came back on stage to bow again.
questions.explanation: 演员被掌声鼓舞(带 by 表被动) → 过去分词;若用 -ing 则成了演员鼓舞掌声,讲不通。

questions.stem: ____ his lines perfectly, the young actor felt proud of himself.
questions.explanation: 他主动记住台词 → 现在分词;台词被记,但状语逻辑主语是 actor(主动),故不用被动。

questions.stem: ____ on a famous novel, the film attracted millions of viewers.
questions.explanation: 影片是被改编自小说,be based on 用被动 → 过去分词;影片不会主动 base,-ing 错。

questions.stem: ____ a bright red costume, the clown ran around the stage.
questions.explanation: 小丑主动穿着戏服 → 现在分词;小丑不是被穿,过去分词错。

questions.stem: ____ by the sad music, the whole audience fell silent.
questions.explanation: 观众被悲伤的音乐打动(带 by 表被动) → 过去分词;-ing 会变成观众打动音乐,讲不通。

questions.stem: ____ a microphone in one hand, the singer walked to the front of the stage.
questions.explanation: 歌手主动手持话筒,表伴随 → 现在分词;话筒被握,但状语逻辑主语是歌手(主动),不用被动。

questions.stem: ____ as the best comedy of the year, the show became hugely popular.
questions.explanation: 节目是被选为年度最佳喜剧 → 过去分词;节目不会主动选,-ing 错。

questions.stem: ____ his first film at the age of twenty, he soon became famous.
questions.explanation: 他主动执导自己的第一部电影 → 现在分词;他不是被导,过去分词错。

questions.stem: ____ for the first time in 1790, the opera is still loved by audiences today.
questions.explanation: 歌剧是被首次上演,与主语 opera 是被动关系 → 过去分词;歌剧不会主动表演,-ing 错。

questions.stem: ____ a heavy box of costumes, the stagehand crossed the dark stage.
questions.explanation: 舞台工作人员主动搬着戏服箱,表伴随 → 现在分词;他不是被搬,过去分词错。

questions.stem: ____ in a small mountain village, the documentary showed everyday country life.
questions.explanation: 纪录片是被拍摄于小山村,与主语 documentary 是被动关系 → 过去分词;影片不会主动拍,-ing 错。

questions.stem: ____ the show with a funny joke, the host quickly put everyone at ease.
questions.explanation: 主持人主动以笑话开场 → 现在分词;主持人不是被开场,过去分词错。

questions.stem: ____ by the actor's sudden appearance, the children screamed with delight.
questions.explanation: 孩子们被演员突然现身吓到(带 by 表被动) → 过去分词;-ing 会变成孩子使人吃惊,与句意不符。

questions.stem: ____ the main character, the actress appeared in almost every scene.
questions.explanation: 女演员主动扮演主角 → 现在分词;她不是被扮演,过去分词错。

questions.stem: ____ as a king, the old actor walked slowly across the stage.
questions.explanation: be dressed as 表“打扮成”,与主语是被动/状态关系 → 过去分词;此处习惯用 dressed,-ing 不合表达。

questions.stem: ____ the script aloud, the director explained each scene to the cast.
questions.explanation: 导演主动朗读剧本,表伴随 → 现在分词;剧本被读,但状语逻辑主语是导演(主动),不用被动。

questions.stem: ____ over a hundred years ago, the play still speaks to today's audiences.
questions.explanation: 剧本是被(人)在一百多年前写成,与主语 play 是被动关系 → 过去分词;剧本不会主动写,-ing 错。

questions.stem: ____ by the weak ending, many viewers left the cinema in silence.
questions.explanation: 观众对软弱的结尾感到失望(带 by 表被动) → 过去分词;-ing 会变成观众令人失望,与句意不符。

questions.stem: ____ in a beautiful old theatre, the play felt even more magical to the audience.
questions.explanation: 戏是被(人)搬上这座剧院上演的,与主语 play 是被动关系 → 过去分词;戏剧不会主动上演,-ing 错。
